name: Ingoku no Kyonyuu Elf ~Karada mo Kokoro mo Kairaku ni Sometsukuse!~
original_name: 淫獄の巨乳エルフ ～体も心も快楽に染めつくせ！～
source:
“I am Tenia, the swordswoman, and I’ve come to vanquish you in the name of justice! Brace yourself!”

With those words, the elf swordswoman Tenia charges at Gorg, the leader of the bandit gang.
But the gap in their power is staggering!
Tenia stands no chance against Gorg—and for good reason. Gorg is a humanoid fiend.

“Heh heh heh… I’m gonna have my fill of fun with you.”

Instead of defeating Gorg, Tenia is captured and made into a toy for him and his crew.
And it doesn’t end there—multiple other fiends also take their turn with her…

“If you survive, we’ll play again sometime.”

Day after day, Tenia is defiled, and slowly, she begins to embrace the pleasure forced upon her.

Then, one day…
Tenia’s companion, Karin, grows uneasy when Tenia doesn’t return and sets out to search for her…

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008623.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
“我是女剑士特妮娅，我是来以正义之名讨伐你的！做好准备吧！”

精灵女剑士特妮亚说完这句话，就向强盗团伙首领戈尔格发起了冲锋。
但他们的实力差距却是惊人！
特妮亚没有机会对抗戈尔格——这是有充分理由的。戈尔格是一个人形恶魔。

“嘿嘿嘿……我会和你一起玩得很开心的。”

泰尼亚并没有打败戈尔格，而是被俘虏并变成了他和他的船员的玩具。
事情并没有结束——还有其他多个恶魔也和她一起轮流……

“如果你能活下来，我们什么时候再玩。”

日复一日，特妮娅被玷污了，慢慢地，她开始拥抱强加给她的快乐。

然后，有一天……
当泰妮亚没有回来时，她的同伴卡琳感到不安，并开始寻找她……
